Scope: One wired fixture, vendor first-effect selection followed by original Off selection, then independent native read. Not a brightness experiment.
Limitations: One observed wired device and vendor process; shared profile IDs do not identify all models or transports.
The vendor process was restarted for the independent read; equal before/after blocks establish final readback equality, not all intermediate behavior.
Brightness was not changed or verified; this evidence does not authorize any new hardware write.
